title: Excavation
mission: The storage area 'sandbox/clutter' is full of junk. Locate 'sandbox/clutter/secret_*.txt' (which contains the flag), create the directory 'sandbox/secure_vault', and move the key into it. Run './verify_vault' to complete the mission!
